enso.advisory_text: 27 July 2026 Climate models suggest El Niño will further intensify, becoming very strong by the October-November-December 2026 season. (updated 06 July 2026) Trunkline No.: (02)8284-0800  local 4920 and 4921

region2_forecast: Metro Manila, Ilocos Region, Cagayan Valley, Cordillera Administrative Region, MIMAROPA, Zambales, Bataan, Bulacan, Cavite, Laguna, and Batangas
Cagayan Valley, Bulacan, Cavite, and Laguna –
Ilocos Norte, Ilocos Sur, Pangasinan, Isabela, Bulacan, Quezon City, Batangas, Tayabas, southern parts of Palawan, Dumangas, Southern Leyte, Eastern Samar, Davao del Sur, and General Santos City

A weak to moderate El Niño is currently present in the tropical Pacific. Climate models indicate that it is likely to intensify and persist through the first half of 2027 (97% probability). There is a 57% probability of El Niño strengthening to a strong event during the July–August–September (JAS) 2026 season, while a very strong El Niño is favored during the October–November–December (OND) 2026 and November–December–January (NDJ) 2026–2027 seasons, with an estimated 81% probability.
